title: Degree bound for circuit execution
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $g_1,\ldots,g_m$ be a list of algebraic gates on $n$ inputs, and evaluate them in order at the formal input variables over $\mathbb{Z}$. For every position $j$, the total degree of the value at that position, taking the value to be zero when the position is out of range, is at most $2^m$.
